aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Brand GMV from Sales
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  COALESCE(b.brand, 'Unknown') AS brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.sub_order_num) AS orders,
  SUM(s.charged_amount) AS gmv,
  AVG(s.charged_amount) AS aov
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales s
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
  ON s.order_id = b.order_id
  AND b.is_active = true
WHERE s.is_active = true
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY gmv DESC;
